records.question: Which section of the Online Safety Act 2023 bans the use of VPNs in the UK?
records.answer: No section of the Online Safety Act 2023 bans VPN use in the UK. ⚖️
records.why: The Act's text and the UK government's July 2026 response confirm there is no ban on VPNs; multiple sources show VPNs remain legal and the government explicitly states it will not ban or age-gate them.
caveats: The government continues to monitor circumvention of online safety protections, so future guidance could change.
